liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (3 reviews): Alabama>Greatest Story is energetic, though the transition is somewhat rough and a flub at the end spoils perfection; Phil dominates the transition from Alabama Getaway into Greatest Story [8][9][10]
- **Lost Sailor** (1 review, 1 other source): Lost Sailor>Saint of Circumstance is rated as exceptional, alongside Alabama>Greatest and China>Rider; The noodle leading into Lost Sailor is included within the Lost Sailor track [3][18]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls this their favorite China>Rider of the Brent era, citing several distinctive segments in the transition jam [7]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): An extra jam between Bob's and Jerry's verses adds muscle, and the jam at the song's end is fantastic [7]
- **Passenger** (1 review): Bobby and Brent push to outer limits; the reviewer finds it wildly rocking and danceable [9]
- **Alabama Getaway** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Alabama Getaway>Greatest Story pairing the best ever heard, like its 12/28/1979 counterpart [14]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer calls Terrapin outstanding [15]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): The beginning is rough, with Bobby singing too fast [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-11-24.mtx.seamons.113741.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 155 min; rated 4.7/5 by 10 [1]
- **gd1979-11-24.sbd.miller.113499.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 153 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has masterful sound, with two patches done incredibly well [18]
- **gd1979-11-24.145590.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 157 min [3]
- **gd1979-11-24.fob.menke.motb-0133.106307.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [5]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds excellent, with full-throated bass and every instrument prominent [16]
- **gd79-11-24.sbd.clugston.10022.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 149 min; rated 4.57/5 by 14 [6]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass is strong in the mix, giving a rich, full-bodied sound; China>Rider has very thick bass [7][15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer finds the band sounding tired, with lowish energy and jams that don't stretch into new territory [12]
- Attendee describes bleacher-style seating, cocktails allowed at seats, and an animated Jerry rocking back and forth during the opener [13]
- Reviewer attended both San Diego shows and replaced an older audience copy with the soundboard [13]
- Taper's era context: the band had eased its harsh stance toward tapers by 1979, though still watching for them [16]
- China>Rider as a show opener was atypical for the Brent era; reviewer ranks it among the era's best [10]
- Unusual for 1979: China>Rider plus a distinctive second-set structure of Alabama>GSET and Space>Sailor>Saint [12]
- Show resembles 12/28/1979 and an East Coast show; first set consistent, second set outrageous [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-11-24.mtx.seamons.113741.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Jubal H. Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT) [1]
- **gd1979-11-24.sbd.miller.113499.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master [2]
- **gd1979-11-24.145590.fob.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (DFC, section 401, row 8 seats 7 & 8)> Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII) [3]. Also: A 0:12 patch in Playin' In The Band comes from the Menke Nakamichi 700 source [3]
- **gd1979-11-24.fob.menke.motb-0133.106307.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Bob Menke and David Minches; source: 2 x Nak cm700's >> Sony TC-D5 >> MAC [5]
- **gd79-11-24.sbd.clugston.10022.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]. Also: Reviewer made an audience recording but taped over it after a soundboard circulated [14]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_12.html) [20]
